audit.whatIsWrong: Blinding Dart was treated as an unquantified threat that shuts off 'your entire trade pattern'.
audit.why: Blinding Dart is 7 seconds flat at every rank and blinds basic attacks only — Five Point Strike, Shuriken Flip and Perfect Execution all land through it. Calling it the whole trade engine teaches you to give up windows you actually own.
audit.corrected: Every stage now carries the 7s figure and separates the attack half of your damage from the spell half.

audit.why: Level 6 and first-item spikes correctly identify the E-into-R window and the Lich Bane burst; the ordering matches his lack of any escape once you are on top of him.

audit.whatIsWrong: Text claimed sitting in Shroud stops 'his next E tick', and blamed the blind for cancelling on-hit spells.
audit.why: Toxic Shot is an on-hit poison that keeps ticking for its duration once applied — being unselectable stops a NEW application, not the damage over time already on you. Blind only suppresses basic attacks, which for Akali means the Assassin's Mark empowered attack.
audit.corrected: Shroud lines now say a fresh dart cannot land while you are unselectable but existing Toxic Shot ticks continue; blind lines now name the empowered attack specifically. Consistent with the mirror at audits/top/teemo__akali.json.

edits.before: Teemo's Q blind turns off your Assassin's Mark empowered auto and any on-hit auto in your combo — your whole trade engine — so eat the E poison and farm at the edge of your Q range instead of walking up.
edits.after: Teemo's Blinding Dart, 7s flat at every rank, cancels your Assassin's Mark empowered attack — the auto half of your trade, not the spells — so eat the E poison and farm at the edge of your Q range.

edits.before: With Shroud (W) you go untargetable in the smoke, so Teemo can't land a blind or his next E tick while you sit inside — step out for one empowered auto, then drop back in to reset before he re-blinds.
edits.after: With Shroud (W) you cannot be selected, so a fresh Blinding Dart cannot land while you sit inside — but Toxic Shot ticks already on you keep running. Step out for one empowered attack, then drop back in.

edits.before: Sit in Shroud (W) to go untargetable, then step out for a single empowered auto and re-enter before he can re-blind or re-poison
edits.after: Sit in Shroud where he cannot select you, then step out for one empowered attack and re-enter before the 7s dart is back

edits.before: Hold Q to blind your empowered auto the instant you step up, so every trade is one-sided poison damage
edits.after: Hold the 7-second Blinding Dart for your empowered attack, so every trade is one-sided poison damage

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are his — Teemo's Q blind cancels your Assassin's Mark empowered auto and any on-hit follow-up, which is your entire trade pattern, so don't walk up to commit a Q he just blinds while his E poison ticks you down. You have no Shroud and no real sustain yet, so farm at the tip of your Q range and accept the chip. Don't burn E trying to chase him; his stealth move speed lets him slip the dash and you end up energy-starved with no escape.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are his — Teemo's Blinding Dart, 7s flat at every rank, cancels your Assassin's Mark empowered attack, so don't walk up to commit into a blind while his E poison ticks you down. Your spells still land through it; it is the attack half you lose. You have no Shroud and no real sustain yet, so farm at the tip of your Q range and accept the chip. Don't burn E chasing him; his stealth move speed slips the dash and you end up energy-starved with no escape.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 even it out — once Shroud (W) is up you go untargetable inside the smoke, so he can't land a blind or refresh E while you're in it. Step out for one Assassin's Mark empowered auto, then drop back in to reset. At 6 it's your window: E-flip onto him, R cast one to dash through the kite, and cast two executes on the missing-health scaling before his stealth speed re-opens the gap. Don't dump Q and E into the wave — you need both up to commit, and a blinded all-in just feeds him.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 even it out — once Shroud (W) is up he cannot select you inside the smoke, so a fresh blind or a new Toxic Shot application cannot land, though poison already on you keeps ticking. Step out for one Assassin's Mark empowered attack, then drop back in to reset. At 6 it's your window: E-flip onto him, R cast one to dash through the kite, and cast two executes on missing health before his stealth speed re-opens the gap. Don't dump Q and E into the wave — you need both to commit.

edits.before: His Q blind shuts off your Assassin's Mark empowered auto and on-hit combo — with only Q and no Shroud you just eat E poison at his range.
edits.after: His Blinding Dart, 7s at every rank, shuts off your Assassin's Mark empowered attack — with only Q and no Shroud you eat E poison at his range.

edits.before: With Shroud (W) up you go untargetable for a clean empowered-auto trade, but his blind and stealth kite still answer it, keeping it even.
edits.after: With Shroud up he cannot select you for a fresh dart, but Toxic Shot keeps ticking and his stealth kite still answers the trade, keeping it even.

edits.before: Lich Bane turns your E, R, Q into a lethal one-combo burst — his blind only eats one auto, not the spell damage.
edits.after: Lich Bane turns your E, R, Q into a lethal one-combo burst — the blind eats one attack, never the spell damage.

edits.before: His blind + kite hurt — build MR, E-Q close. Akali wins the Blinding Dart cooldown windows.
edits.after: His blind + kite hurt — burst with spells, not autos. Akali wins the Blinding Dart gaps.

edits.after: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Take it when Teemo's Blinding Dart is down, 7s flat.

edits.before: - Teemo Blinding Dart: matchup-defining — Blinds your autos. Burst with spells. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Teemo Blinding Dart, 7s at every rank: matchup-defining — it blinds attacks only, so burst with spells. - Move Quick, 14s: his kite. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only, never chip.

edits.after: Blinds attacks, never spells, and it is 7s flat. Burst with Q, E and R.
